tools.name: cqc_plugin_info
tools.description: Explain the read-only CQC Provider Compliance Navigator scope.

tools.name: cqc_source_status
tools.description: Return bounded freshness/conflict status for official CQC evidence maintained by the decision service.

tools.name: cqc_workflow_guide
tools.description: Choose the relevant CQC workflow category without making a regulatory determination.

tools.name: cqc_preflight_input_guide
tools.description: Show bounded fact categories to prepare before using a CQC preflight workflow. Use only user-supplied facts; never infer or default missing provider, activity, location, role, or event facts.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "cqc_preflight_input_guide" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Show bounded fact categories to prepare before using a CQC preflight workflow. Use only user-supplied facts; never infer or default missing provider, activity, …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
